About

Nitsan Kolko is an Israeli pianist, composer and arranger. His debut album Allusions — a duo with multi-instrumentalist Hillai Govreen — was praised by JazzNU, Haaretz, Música-Terra and Cazkolik, and the two also compose and arrange original music for a nonet of woodwinds and strings. Alongside the duo, he leads a big band, directs a gospel choir, fronts a trio of his own music and performs solo, and has played as a sideman with many of today's leading jazz musicians.
